channel.title: Fox Lessons Blog
channel.description: Writing on learning an instrument as an adult, practice that sticks, and playing with other people. From Daniel Fox in Denver.

item.title: Music lessons or music therapy: which are you looking for?
item.description: The difference between music lessons and music therapy in plain terms: what each is for, who provides each, and Denver options for both. From a Denver music teacher.

item.title: What's the best instrument for a kid with ADHD?
item.description: A Denver teacher on choosing an instrument for an ADHD kid: why fit beats rankings, what the evidence supports, and what to do when your kid wants drums and you want piano.

item.title: How to practice guitar when you have ADHD
item.description: A Denver teacher on practicing guitar with ADHD: songs you choose, sessions that go for a feeling instead of minutes, and how to start when starting is the wall.

item.title: Starting again after years away
item.description: A Denver music teacher on coming back to an instrument as an adult: why the love goes dormant, what the restart really looks like, and how lessons help it stick.

item.title: Am I too old to learn an instrument?
item.description: A Denver music teacher on learning an instrument as an adult: what the research says about age, what actually stops adults, and how lessons built for adults work.
